The Big Idea: Build the Foundation for a Lifetime of Freedom.
What It Is: This program establishes a clear, consistent language between you and your dog, turning confusion into communication and creating reliable obedience.
Key Components:
The Big 5: Mastering Sit, Stay, Place (go-to-bed), Recall (come when called), and Loose Leash Walking.

Engagement: Teaching your dog to focus on you first, not the environment.

Motivation: Building your dog's desire to work and learn for reward.
Best For: Puppies, new rescues, and dogs with no prior training who need a solid foundation.

The Big Idea: Bridge the Gap Between 'Good Dog' and 'Balanced Dog'
What It Is: This is designed to correct and change problematic, ingrained habits. We don't just stop the behavior; we teach a calm, alternative replacement.
Key Components:
Nuisance Control: Targeting jumping on guests, excessive barking, counter-surfing, and door-bolting.

Impulse Control: Teaching your dog to wait for direction rather than reacting.

Emotional Reset: Addressing the anxiety, excitement, or frustration driving the behavior.
Best For: Dogs with minor behavior issues like leash reactivity, lunging, snapping, jumping, or door-bolting.

The Big Idea: Transform Crisis into Calm with Specialized, Deep-Dive Care
What It Is: This is our most advanced program for serious cases that require intense, expert intervention. We focus on transforming a dog's emotional response to its triggers.
Key Components:
Reactivity: Working through intense leash lunging and overreaction to stimulants.

Fear & Aggression: A systemic, safety-first approach to human aggression, dog aggression, or severe anxiety.

Intensive Counter-Conditioning: Fundamentally changing how your dog feels about what they once feared or hated.
Best For: Dogs showing true aggressiveness, severe fear, or those with a documented bite history.

The Big Idea: The Real-World Proof: Building Stability in a Social Setting
What It Is: Once you have the foundation, this class is where you proof it. Your dog learns to ignore other dogs and people, making "listening to you" their main priority.
Key Components:
Social Neutrality: Teaching your dog to exist calmly alongside others without needing to meet or react.

Proofing Skills: Testing your obedience with high-level distractions.

Structure & Drill: Practice exercises that build reliability and owner confidence.
Best For: Graduates of individual programs who need to socialize safely and proof their skills in public.

The Big Idea: Fast-Track Your Results with the Trainer’s Full Undivided Attention
What It Is: A customized training journey dedicated 100% to you and your dog. We solve problems specific to your home, your lifestyle, and your individual goals.
Key Components:
Personalized Plan: A strategy built just for you, not a cookie-cutter class.

Home Manners: Working in your real-life environment to fix real-life issues.

Accelerated Learning: Direct coaching that helps you progress faster by avoiding mistakes.
Best For: Owners with busy schedules or those who want a custom-tailored plan for their specific home layout.

The Big Idea: Expert BPKNINES Guidance, Anywhere in the World.
What It Is: Distance is no longer a factor. We use live video coaching to teach you to be the expert, enabling you to train on your own schedule with professional oversight.
Key Components:
Virtual Consults: Live video sessions to diagnose problems and demonstrate solutions.

Video Review: Submit videos of your practice for detailed breakdown and critique.

Actionable Homework: Clear, digital lesson plans you can implement immediately.
Best For: Long-distance clients or DIY-minded owners who want expert guidance while doing the work themselves.

The Big Idea: Turn Your Passion for Paws into a Professional Career.
What It Is: A professional mentorship path designed to train the next generation of BPKNINES-caliber trainers. We cover theory, technical skill, and the business of dog training.
Key Components:
Canine Psychology: Understanding how dogs think, learn, and experience the world.

Advanced Handling: Mastering leash work, body language, and timing.

Business Bootcamp: Learning how to start, market, and manage a successful training brand.
Best For: Aspiring professionals or high-level hobbyists looking to master the craft of dog training.
